invariants: The complete openFDA enforcement export is the structured recall record corpus.
FDA recall announcements remain a distinct selected-publication surface with separate provenance.
No automatic record linkage or silent deduplication is performed.
Recall records do not establish medicine safety causality.
Missing historical announcements are not negative evidence.
limitations: FDA states that announcements remain live for three years and delegates older web captures across multiple archive services; it publishes no single complete historical announcement inventory.
Historical announcement completeness is therefore not claimed or used as a prerequisite for the complete structured enforcement corpus.
The current notice workbook, live documentation, FDA archive documentation, and legacy archive index were retained as distinct source documentation.
Public release and external publication remain separately gated.
